title: Made a tool that lets you vibe code publishable games end-to-end
author: lukeiamyourpapi
selftext:
Hello fellow vibe coders, we made a tool that lets you vibe code games end-to-end from assets to game logic. It's a fork of Godot to create an app where AI is deeply integrated.

In the video, you can see it building a 2D bullet heaven from a single prompt. It implements player, enemies, combat, and health in one pass.

Some highlights:

* It can create a playable game in 20 minutes
* Generates 2D and 3D assets + scenes via prompts
* Write and modify scripts
* Work with any files in the filesystem
* It can add animations to any character or NPC
* You can prompt any mechanic into existence

Looking for devs who'll try it and tell us what breaks! You can try it out at [https://app.moonlakeai.com/](https://app.moonlakeai.com/)!
